BuyInDeferral.name: Buy In Deferral
BuyInDeferral.definition: Specifies if the buy-in transaction was deferred or not.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Identification of the financial instrument of the buy-in instruction.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Quantity of financial instrument concerned by the buy-in transaction.

BuyInPrice.name: Buy In Price
BuyInPrice.definition: Price of the traded financial instrument in the buy-in transaction.

CashCompensationAmount.name: Cash Compensation Amount
CashCompensationAmount.definition: Amount of money that has to be paid by the failing trading party in case of an unsuccessful or partially successful buy-in transaction.
